items.title: Tuts Washington Interview, 1968-09-02
items.q: I worked with Andrew Anderson, he's a chumpet.

ctx.x: let me be looking down dear dear dear

Well, right now I ain't doing anything. I'm just working at her church about two weeks now. I'm doing it. Last Thursday is Monday. Now, next Monday I'm going to get out there. She's going to get me to get me to get me. With the band? No, she's going to get her daughter and her cousin. And I'm waiting to get me to get me to get me to get me. But it's my luck, I just had stopped waiting at the Gold Room on St. Charles Street. I got to see a few months ago after I left the court of two sisters I went to the Gold…
And he want to bring it.
